expectation.note: Days 1,8,15,22,29 of every month; the 29→1 gap is 3, 2 or 4 days depending on month length.

normative_evidence.quote: steps are evaluated just within the field they are applied to

normative_evidence.note: contrast: RRULE's INTERVAL counts periods from DTSTART; cron has no seed at all
normative_evidence.quote: The DTSTART ... are used as the seed values, and then the RRULE is applied to the seed values

rationale: The structural difference between the two grammars, stated as one executable vector: cron is a predicate over instants with no origin, RRULE is a generator from an anchor. Any unified model must reproduce both columns.
title: Cron has no anchor: '*/7' in the day field restarts each month
